name: the Death of the Video Star
source:
Worthy Undone wakes up in the apartment of a woman who reincarnates people for a living, and has to deal with the world she created. Killing God is as easy as a baseball bat to the head and a lifetime of guilt afterwards; it's even easier when She stays dead afterwards, but Worthy isn't quite that lucky.

The Death of the Video Star is a visual novel about dealing with the aftermath of killing God, and maybe having to kill Her again.

[From [url=https://ghostsontv.itch.io/death-of-the-video-star]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《值得撤销》在一位以转世为生的女人的公寓里醒来，她必须面对她创造的世界。杀死上帝就像用棒球棒击中头部一样容易，之后就会感到终生愧疚；当她死后就更容易了，但沃西就没那么幸运了。

《视频明星之死》是一部视觉小说，讲述了如何处理杀死上帝的后果，甚至可能不得不再次杀死她。

[来自[url=https://ghostsontv.itch.io/death-of-the-video-star]Itch.io[/url]]
